note: Every case names the automated check that executes it. A case with no executor is a claim about the product that nobody runs.

test_cases.title: Every named fixture builds and returns what it promised
test_cases.oracle_source: Claims -> aic_hrm_uat_data engine docstring: a spec declares its outputs
test_cases.catches_bug: A setup quietly returning fewer ids than it declared, so a later test reads undefined
test_cases.steps:
1. Apply the whole catalogue
2. Compare declared outputs with returned keys
test_cases.expected: 26 fixtures build; none returns fewer outputs than its spec declares

test_cases.title: A fixture id describes the fixture it names
test_cases.oracle_source: Claims -> naming contract <entity>.<state>.<lifecycle>.<shape>
test_cases.catches_bug: An id drifting from its metadata, so the dataset stops describing itself
test_cases.steps:
1. Read the catalogue
2. Split each id against entity/state/lifecycle
test_cases.expected: Every id agrees with its own metadata and carries a doc line

test_cases.title: Applying a fixture twice does not create a second copy
test_cases.oracle_source: Claims -> engine docstring: reproducible, so a half-finished run restarts
test_cases.catches_bug: A restarted run doubling its own data and reporting counts nobody can reconcile
test_cases.steps:
1. Apply a fixture
2. Apply it again
3. Count the records
test_cases.expected: Same ids returned, record count unchanged

test_cases.title: Cleanup returns the database to exactly where it started
test_cases.oracle_source: Claims -> engine docstring: every created record is ledgered, removed in reverse
test_cases.catches_bug: Leftovers from the last run being read as this run's result
test_cases.steps:
1. Count rows in eleven models
2. Apply everything
3. Reset
4. Count again
test_cases.expected: Counts identical before and after; no fixture instance survives

test_cases.title: Removing a fixture removes what was built on it
test_cases.oracle_source: Claims -> engine docstring on cascade
test_cases.catches_bug: An orphaned scorecard pointing at an employee no fixture accounts for
test_cases.steps:
1. Apply a fixture chain
2. Clean the root
3. List what remains
test_cases.expected: Dependants are removed; unrelated fixtures are left alone

test_cases.title: Seeding is refused when UAT mode is off
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> data/uat_mode.xml: installing the module must not allow writes
test_cases.catches_bug: A fixture RPC writing business data on a live database because the module happened to be installed
test_cases.steps:
1. Set aic_hrm.uat_mode to 0
2. Call apply_fixtures
test_cases.expected: Refused with a message naming the parameter; nothing is created

test_cases.title: A performance manager cannot drive the fixtures
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> ir.model.access.csv: the fixture models are HR-admin only
test_cases.catches_bug: Any logged-in manager creating or deleting business records wholesale
test_cases.steps:
1. Log in as a manager
2. Call apply_fixtures
test_cases.expected: AccessError; nothing is created

test_cases.title: A locked cycle refuses every edit
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> aic_hrm_cycle.ensure_editable; spec section on cycle lock
test_cases.catches_bug: A closed performance record changing after people were paid against it
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the locked cycle's key result
2. Write a new current value
test_cases.expected: Refused with the lock message; the value is unchanged

test_cases.title: A one-day cycle does not divide by zero
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> aic_hrm_progress_report ELAPSED, NULLIF on the cycle length
test_cases.catches_bug: The report crashing, or silently returning nothing, for a one-day cycle
test_cases.steps: 1. Query the progress report for the single-day cycle
test_cases.expected: The query returns without error

test_cases.title: An objective with no key results is not a zero
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> aic_hrm_objective._compute_score over an empty set
test_cases.catches_bug: An empty objective dragging a department's average down to zero
test_cases.steps: 1. Read the empty objective
test_cases.expected: It has no key results and stays in draft

test_cases.title: Roll-up holds across all five objective levels
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> _check_level_anchor and the five-level design in the spec
test_cases.catches_bug: A level silently dropping out of the roll-up chain
test_cases.steps: 1. Read the five objectives in the chain
test_cases.expected: Company, branch, department, team and individual are all present

test_cases.title: A key result untouched for a month reads as stale
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> aic_hrm_key_result.is_stale and cycle.stale_days
test_cases.catches_bug: Staleness never firing, so the alert rules that depend on it never fire
test_cases.steps: 1. Read the stale key result
test_cases.expected: is_stale is true

test_cases.title: A draft period result never reaches a report
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> progress report WHERE pr.state = 'confirmed'; spec scoring
test_cases.catches_bug: Unreviewed numbers appearing in a leadership report as if agreed
test_cases.steps: 1. Query the report for the draft-result target
test_cases.expected: No rows

test_cases.title: Beating a lower-is-better target scores at the cycle cap
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> utils.achievement lower branch, clamped to score_cap
test_cases.catches_bug: A defect-rate KPI scoring above the scale and inflating a scorecard
test_cases.steps: 1. Read achievement on the lower-is-better target
test_cases.expected: Exactly 1.0 - the raw 1.4 is clamped by this cycle's cap

test_cases.title: Overachievement clamps at the cycle's own cap, not at 1.0
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> utils.clamp with the cycle score_cap; Google re:Work 0..1
test_cases.catches_bug: A cap of 1.2 ignored, so overachievement is invisible or unbounded
test_cases.steps: 1. Read the score of a KPI at 150% of target in a cap-1.2 cycle

test_cases.title: A scorecard weighing 80 cannot be submitted
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> aic_hrm_kpi_assignment._validate_state_change weight gate
test_cases.catches_bug: The import defect that produced draft scorecards while reporting success
test_cases.steps: 1. Submit the 80% scorecard
test_cases.expected: Refused, naming 80 and 100; the state stays draft

test_cases.title: Thirds are accepted
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> float_compare at the declared precision, not float equality
test_cases.catches_bug: 33.33/33.33/33.34 refused for a rounding reason nobody can see
test_cases.steps: 1. Submit the thirds scorecard
test_cases.expected: Submitted

test_cases.title: Two of three raters: the peer aggregate is absent
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> stage min_raters; CCL/DecisionWise practice in the domain pack
test_cases.catches_bug: An average over two people, which is a name
test_cases.steps: 1. Read the review after two of three answers
test_cases.expected: peer_feedback_ready false, peer_score_avg 0.0

test_cases.title: The third answer releases the aggregate
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> min_raters threshold in aic_hrm_review_template
test_cases.catches_bug: A threshold that never opens, making 360 feedback useless
test_cases.steps: 1. Read the review after the third answer
test_cases.expected: Ready, with a non-zero average

test_cases.title: Nobody may answer for a rater who has no login
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> submit_feedback authorisation, fixed after the /cso audit
test_cases.catches_bug: The forgery hole: sudo ran before the check, so anyone could submit as an external rater, untraceably
test_cases.steps: 1. As a peer, submit on the external rater's invitation
test_cases.expected: Refused; the invitation is still open

test_cases.title: An applied calibration line is immutable and undeletable
test_cases.oracle_source: Statutes -> audit-record practice; calibration write and unlink guards
test_cases.catches_bug: Deleting the evidence of a closed-door score change - the missing unlink guard found by the /cso audit
test_cases.steps:
1. Edit the applied line
2. Delete it
test_cases.expected: Both refused

test_cases.title: A library pack applies as draft and stamps the role
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> action_apply creating draft objectives; role on hr.employee
test_cases.catches_bug: The library deciding an approved plan, or the role dimension staying empty
test_cases.steps:
1. Apply the pack to one person
2. Read the objectives and the employee
test_cases.expected: Objectives are draft; the employee carries the library role

test_cases.title: The org chart carries the people who break things
test_cases.oracle_source: Claims -> fixtures_org docstring: external rater, leaver, no department, no job position
test_cases.catches_bug: A dataset of only well-formed employees, which never meets the ones that break the product
test_cases.steps: 1. Read the four awkward employees
test_cases.expected: No login, archived, no department, no job position - all present

test_cases.title: The environment is up and is the UAT database
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> odoo.uat.conf dbfilter locking the server to AIC_HRM_UAT
test_cases.catches_bug: A run scored against the customer database - this project has captured customer screenshots twice for exactly this reason
test_cases.steps:
1. Request the login page
2. Read one model
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200 from the UAT database

test_cases.title: All three personas can log in
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> org.base.D0 outputs: admin, manager and member logins
test_cases.catches_bug: Browser failures later that are really a login problem
test_cases.steps: 1. Authenticate as each persona
test_cases.expected: Each returns a uid

test_cases.title: The progress report equals its own sources
test_cases.oracle_source: Comparable -> the report is a UNION of check-ins and confirmed results
test_cases.catches_bug: The report inventing or losing rows - the unstable row_number() ids did exactly this
test_cases.steps:
1. Count report rows
2. Count check-ins and confirmed results
test_cases.expected: rows == check-ins + confirmed results, exactly

test_cases.title: Every core model answers a read
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> the fourteen models in the suite
test_cases.catches_bug: A model left empty by a broken fixture, discovered only in a screenshot
test_cases.steps: 1. Count rows in each of fourteen models
test_cases.expected: All non-zero

test_cases.title: The operating loop is visible in the menu bar
test_cases.oracle_source: Familiarity -> the PDCA grouping agreed with the user; the classification rule written into aic_hrm_menus.xml
test_cases.catches_bug: A regroup that loses a stage, leaving its screens unreachable
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the Performance app
2. Read the menu bar
test_cases.expected: Cockpit, Plan, Execute, Monitor, Review, Reporting, Library, Configuration

test_cases.title: Operations live in their stage, not in Configuration
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> classification rule: a wizard is an operation
test_cases.catches_bug: A monthly data-entry job filed under Settings, where nobody will look
test_cases.steps: 1. Read the items of Plan, Execute and Configuration
test_cases.expected: The five wizards sit in their stage; none is in Configuration

test_cases.title: Period results are reachable from the menu
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> the customer's request for monthly and quarterly figures
test_cases.catches_bug: The data the customer asked for existing with no way to open it
test_cases.steps: 1. Execute > Period Results
test_cases.expected: The list opens with rows

test_cases.title: Every screen in every stage opens without a console error
test_cases.oracle_source: Product -> the ir.model.data enumeration in test_screen_smoke, now walked in a real browser
test_cases.catches_bug: A screen that renders server-side and throws in the browser - the New Key Result crash was one
test_cases.steps: 1. Walk all six stages and open every item
test_cases.expected: 24 screens open; the console stays empty

test_cases.title: The weight gate refuses on screen and says the number
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> the import incident: a refusal nobody sees is no refusal
test_cases.catches_bug: A silent draft: the person believes the plan is in place and it is not
test_cases.steps:
1. Open the 80% scorecard
2. Press Submit
test_cases.expected: A message naming 80 and 100 appears; the record stays draft

test_cases.title: Progress vs Plan opens as a chart and re-groups
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> the customer's ask: progress against target over time
test_cases.catches_bug: A report that draws only one way, so the question asked cannot be answered
test_cases.steps:
1. Reporting > Progress vs Plan
2. Switch to pivot, then to list
test_cases.expected: Chart, pivot and grouped list all render from the same model

test_cases.title: The report groups by time, department and position
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> the customer named week, month, quarter, department, position
test_cases.catches_bug: A dimension that exists in the view and returns no buckets
test_cases.steps:
1. Group by department, job and owner
2. Group by week, month, quarter
test_cases.expected: Every grouping returns at least one bucket with a figure

test_cases.title: The executive overview opens on a cycle that has data
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> a leadership dashboard exists to be read at a glance
test_cases.catches_bug: Opening on the newest cycle by start date - empty the moment next period is created early
test_cases.steps: 1. Reporting > Executive Overview
test_cases.expected: Figures, not the empty state

test_cases.title: A manager sees aggregates and no rater name
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> anonymity by construction, documented in aic_hrm_feedback
test_cases.catches_bug: A rater identifiable from the review screen, which ends honest feedback
test_cases.steps: 1. As a manager, open the member's review
test_cases.expected: No peer name appears anywhere on the screen

test_cases.title: Below the threshold the aggregate is absent, not rounded
test_cases.oracle_source: Purpose -> min_raters; an average of two is a name
test_cases.catches_bug: A greyed-out or rounded figure, which still leaks two opinions
test_cases.steps:
1. Create a review with no answers
2. Read its peer fields
test_cases.expected: Not ready, average exactly zero

test_cases.title: Close a cycle at enterprise scale within 60s
test_cases.oracle_source: Claims -> CLAUDE.md: close cycle < 60s at 2,000 employees / 80k lines

test_cases.steps:
1. Seed the large lot
2. Move the cycle to review and closed, timed
test_cases.expected: Under 60 seconds, measured and printed
